Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Stationery Solutions Inc. specializes in the retail sale of stationery and paper products, including writing instruments, notebooks, office supplies, and educational materials. Our operations focus on providing high-quality products to consumers and businesses while maintaining a commitment to excellent customer service. We have implemented robust inventory management practices and have an operational, professionally monitored alarm system in place due to the value of our inventory exceeding $500,000. Additionally, we ensure compliance with sourcing guidelines by only working with reputable suppliers. Our operational model is primarily retail-focused, with less than 20% of total sales conducted online, minimizing exposure to cyber theft.
